title: Add user-facing timeout error display
body: MetricsProvider now sets error='timeout' on fetch timeout, but no widget currently renders this state with a meaningful message to the user. Consider adding a specific UI treatment for the 'timeout' error in the widgets (e.g., 'Failed to load — network timeout' with a retry button).
rationale: Right now a timeout error would render as the generic error state ('Failed to load: timeout') which is not user-friendly.
